easy.q: Russia spreads across how many continents?
easy.fact: Europe and Asia, split by the Ural Mountains.

easy.q: How many seconds do players get to write their Final Jeopardy! answer?
easy.fact: The 'Think!' music that plays was written by Merv Griffin.

easy.q: How many players drop into a standard Fortnite Battle Royale match?
easy.fact: The last one standing earns a Victory Royale.

easy.q: How many U.S. presidents have resigned from office?
How many major championships does men's golf have each year?
easy.fact: The Masters, PGA Championship, U.S. Open and The Open.

medium.q: In what year was the first email sent?
medium.fact: Ray Tomlinson picked the @ sign to split the user from the computer.

medium.q: How many players does each side have on the field in rugby union?
In Back to the Future, how many miles per hour does the DeLorean need to hit to time travel?
How old was Justin Bieber when Baby came out?
How many U.S. states border exactly one other state?
medium.fact: Maine. It touches only New Hampshire.

hard.q: How tall is the Christ the Redeemer statue in Rio, in feet, not counting its base?
How many miles long was Hadrian's Wall, to the nearest mile?
hard.fact: The Romans built it across northern England starting in AD 122.

hard.q: How many career strikeouts did Nolan Ryan have, the MLB record?
hard.fact: He also threw a record seven no-hitters.

hard.q: How many symphonies did Beethoven finish?
hard.fact: He was almost completely deaf when he wrote the Ninth.
